method: Read source/diff/16 revision tests and raw regression receipts; no repeated cargo run, formal app, Agent or user data operation.
reviewedBoundaries: hintUnchanged compares exact requested/root/resolved locations and opaque metadata version, then rechecks identity; it does not read bytes or provide a fresh content receipt.

content and changed hint consume the same protected open handle; full digest/size/read-after/path/root identity checks remain. Same selected pathname replacement obtains a new receipt; redirected alias/root targets are rejected.
Original explicit open/read/copy callers use unchanged DeliveryError mapping; OS ErrorKind is retained only for typed revision errors. Missing is not PermissionDenied.
Global bounded file_read_check and main-webview admission remain; pending/busy return without backend retry. Pending does not claim the OS operation stopped.

16 controlled tests cover hint/no body, change/atomic replacement, metadata-equivalent forced content, root identity replacement, redirects, read race, Unix FIFO/directory, limits and wire mapping. Metadata-equivalent test is a model, not proof ctime can be forged on this Mac.

observedTests.initialRed: 3 failed / 2 passed retained; original exit code not captured, not invented

limitations: No Windows or alternate filesystem/TCC denial/native IPC experiment performed by this reviewer.
Parent browser verification is separate and controlled IPC cannot validate real OS slots or filesystem event timing.
Backend metadata observation alone does not close P20; no full Agent/workflow acceptance.
